activation: After one complete controlled development model trial passes its independent audit; freeze source revision before first run
scope: Three different upright initial scenes, paired geometry/GraspGen comparison; not clutter, size, or general success-rate validation
initial_conditions: Existing --visual-fixture upright and --seed generator, no preview or rejection sampling of seeds
segmenter: geometry for both backends; no claim of project-finetuned segmenter evaluation
metrics: all request counts and rejection reasons
model request workflow and proxy latency
sampled whole-GPU peak memory and sampling coverage/errors
records: All run outputs, raw phase RGB-D, source snapshots, config and logs persist to cloud; selected new JSON and summary pushed to linux-based
interpretation: Report each case and each backend numerator/3; no independence claim for candidate batches or adjacent frames
failure_policy: Keep every failure. Finish or explicitly report an externally interrupted cohort; any later fix starts a new versioned cohort.
gpu_memory_measurement: 2-second sampled whole-device usage, including persistent GUI/model services; lower bound on true peak, not isolated model allocator usage
model_service_state: already warm; official sample cold/warm measurements remain separately scoped evidence
